definitions.explanation: In grafting, the rooted plant onto which a cutting from another plant is joined. The rootstock supplies the roots and often controls vigor and disease resistance, while the grafted part determines the fruit or flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧な{台木|だいぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
カボチャ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{台木|だいぎ}にしてスイカ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{接|つ}ぐ→接ぐ：02471_tsugu⟧。
examples.english: Watermelons are grafted onto squash rootstock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{台木|だいぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{収穫量|しゅうかくりょう}→収穫量：29470_shuukakuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安定|あんてい}→安定：01703_antei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Using a disease-resistant rootstock keeps the fruit harvest stable.

notes:
A gardening and farming term, used together with ⟦{穂木|ほぎ}→穂木：31015_hogi⟧, the cutting grafted on top. Outside horticulture, {台木|だいぎ} can also mean a wooden block used as a base or stand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台木|だいぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接|つ}ぐ→接ぐ：02471_tsugu⟧: to graft onto a rootstock
- {台木|だいぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|そだ}てる: to raise rootstock
- {台木|だいぎ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{穂木|ほぎ}→穂木：31015_hogi⟧: rootstock and scion

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{穂木|ほぎ}→穂木：31015_hogi⟧: scion — the upper part that bears the fruit or flowers
